personal_info.summary: C# Developer with a strong focus on delivering high-quality, maintainable code. Experienced in designing, consuming, and implementing REST API integrations to enhance system functionality and performance. Lifelong learner currently advancing expertise in AWS, with a strong passion for cybersecurity, particularly in blue team roles. Committed to staying ahead in defending systems and ensuring robust security practices.

Transitioned into a backend engineering role focusing on fixing bugs and defects related to app integration.
Included API consumption and debugging, attaching and testing API calls through Postman, and working with data in JSON format.
Worked with C# language, .NET framework, and NUnit for unit testing.
Operated across multiple environments such as LOCAL, TE-DEV, QAE, SANDBOX, and TE-PROD.
Interacted with SQL databases for data validation and queries, edited .config files to manage application settings, and contributed to API documentation using YAML.
Provided remote support for Windows and Unix servers for various Mexican government agencies.
Used MobaXterm to connect via SSH for server administration and troubleshooting.
Monitored and reviewed active processes to identify performance issues.
Ensured service continuity in critical systems through prompt remote intervention.
Provided remote technical support to end users in the USA and Canada.
Managed Active Directory: password resets, user account creation, and permission updates.
Used Azure for user provisioning and MFA unlocks through Azure AD cloud portal.
Troubleshot VPN certificates, network printers, drivers, and other software/hardware issues.
Provided on-site support for DELL-EMC storage equipment across various data centers.
Performed hardware troubleshooting, disk replacements, installations, and implementations.
Used iDRAC connections for in-depth server inspections and diagnostics.
Performed remote integration of telecommunications sites for T-Mobile USA.
